title: Trace a nested loop
prompt: Read `nested(a, b)` (already implemented). Set up the state table for the call `nested(1, 3)`: rows for each (i, j) pair, and predict the return value by hand first. Then make the tests pass by *keeping the code as-is* — this challenge grades your understanding, the code is already correct.

tests.name: nested trace value
tests.hint: For each i, inner j runs i..b; j - i is the offset. Sum them.
